text: {"question":"Which part of the results section provides evidence that the variable‑curvature model shows a decelerated phase close to redshift zero, and what statistical analysis supports this claim?","reference_answer":"The results discuss posterior distributions and correlation analysis of the VC parameters, showing that despite internal degeneracies, the VC model can reproduce background expansion histories that include a decelerated phase near z≈0. The Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) is used to quantify the complexity penalty, indicating that the model’s larger parameter space is only partially constrained by low‑redshift data, yet still supports the deceleration feature."}
